The answer is **Unión**: Real Unión, the club from Irún, was one of La Liga's founding members in 1929, and its nickname "Txuri-beltz" means white-black. I couldn't confirm the exact 1928–29 kit design, and the founding year is sometimes given as 1928 in the sources I found ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Real_Uni%C3%B3n)). This replaces my earlier answer of Madrid.

CONFIDENCE: 75
